The photograph stages a fictional scene from 2003, imagining Prince at the age of 34 on his ranch in Wyoming. * **Book Information:** The book central to the artwork's theme, and presumably the one depicted, is Erik Prince's autobiography, **_Civilian Warriors_**. The project’s focuses on Erik Prince at exactly my age, thirty-four years old, on his ranch near Cody, Wyoming. And it’s set in 2003." > **On the book depicted:** "My work on Erik Prince is based a lot on research. This In particular I drew from his book, _Civilian Warriors_ and autobiography of sorts that he wrote to sort of clear his name—that I’ve read a punishing amount of times."
